'''Politics and elections'''

**Former [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli prime ministers]] [[Naftali Bennett]] of [[Bennett 2026]] and [[Yair Lapid]] of [[Yesh Atid]] merge their [[List of political parties in Israel|parties]] into [[Together (Israel)|Together – Led by Bennett]] in an effort to oust [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] in the upcoming elections.
